title: WITNESS PROTECTION // SUMMER ISLES RESORT MANAGER
narrative: At a beachfront bamboo tiki bar on the Summer Isles, a huge bearded man in a Hawaiian floral tunic shakes a coconut cocktail. 'Gods I was strong then!' laughs Robert Baratheon, slipping on bamboo sunglasses. 'Lancel thought he gave me strong wine; I paid that wild boar twenty silver stags to play dead! Being king was boring, Ned wouldn't stop scolding me, and Cersei is crazy. Now I manage happy hour and play steel drums every Tuesday!'
resolvesPlotHole: Robert Baratheon Faking the Boar Hunting Accident
introducesPlotHole: King Robert's Witness Protection Drum Circle

options.text: Send Cersei a postcard critiquing her wine cellar selections.
Pay Stannis's shadow baby child support with rum bottles.
Fly back to Westeros to show the realm how to party.
